items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: First I joined Cal Tjader on the West Coast, and then Ahmad Jamal, then I went from Ahmad Jamal to Count Basie.

ctx.x: ‘73 to about ‘75 or ‘76, somewhere around there. Then I went back later for about a year. First I joined Cal Tjader on the West Coast, and then Ahmad Jamal, then I went from Ahmad Jamal to Count Basie. I couldn’t read music.
Well that’s interesting. When you get the bass book for Count Basie, what does it look like? Is it chord charts? Is it, you know — or did you learn by listening to the band?
